strings.name: Thomas J. Sargent
strings.summary: Sargent studies rational expectations and monetary and fiscal policy. His methods examine how policy changes reshape economic decisions. He previously taught at the University of Minnesota, the University of Chicago, Stanford University and New York University. He shared the 2011 economics Nobel with Christopher Sims. In 2026 he joined the Federal Reserve’s inflation-framework task force and returned to Wharton as Rowan Distinguished Professor of Finance.
